description: The plot illustrates how Macro-F1 score varies with the number of tokens for two methods, “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information,” with each line accompanied by a semi-transparent shaded band around it. The x-axis is labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.5 to 1.5 with regularly spaced tick labels at about 0.2 intervals (e.g., 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.4). The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 score (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from about 48 to 58 with tick labels spaced by 2 units. The “MATTER (ours)” series is drawn as a solid pink line with circular markers; it starts near 55% at the leftmost x value, rises to a local high near 57% around ~0.7, reaches its highest point near 58–59% around ~0.9, then declines to about 56% around ~1.1–1.2, increases again to roughly 57% near ~1.35, and ends near 55% at the rightmost x value. The “w/o material information” series is drawn as a solid purple line with circular markers; it begins around 52–53% at the leftmost x value, increases to about 55% by roughly ~0.7, stays near 55–56% through the mid-range (around ~0.8 to ~1.2), rises to about 57% near ~1.35, and then drops to roughly 52% at the rightmost x value.
